info.description: SaaS product modules that can be enabled/disabled per tenant. Defines what features are available.

key.description: Machine key matching config/product_modules.json (e.g. channel_whatsapp, delivery_dispatch)

enabled_globally.description: If true, module is active for all tenants regardless of entitlements

required_env_vars.description: Array of env var keys that must be set for this module to function

required_workflows.description: Array of workflow keys from workflow_registry.json

depends_on.description: Array of module keys this module depends on
